description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright API documentation, including functions to create markdown links for classes and members, renderer functions for different languages, and URL transformations.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates markdown links for classes, methods, properties, or events based on language and output type.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content to point to the correct URLs on the Playwright documentation site, with special handling for release notes mode.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation paths.
